import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static class Cell {
        int r, c, dis;
        Cell(int r, int c, int dis) {
            this.r = r;
            this.c = c;
            this.dis = dis;
        }
    }

    static final int[] dRow = {-1, 0, 1, 0};
    static final int[] dCol = {0, -1, 0, 1};
    static Queue<Cell> q = new LinkedList<>();
    static char[] buffer = new char[16];
    static int totalVertices, sourceNode, sinkNode, m, threshold, totalPath, height[], gap[], edgeCap[][], edgeFlow[][], pathBuffer[];
    static boolean gridMark[][], baseGrid[][], pathDetected;

    static void dfsFlow(int u, int bottleneck) {
        if (u == sinkNode) {
            height[0] = bottleneck;
            pathDetected = true;
            return;
        }
        int minH = sinkNode + 2;
        for (int v = 0; v <= sinkNode + 1; ++v) {
            if (edgeFlow[u][v] < edgeCap[u][v]) {
                minH = Math.min(minH, height[v]);
                if (height[u] == height[v] + 1) {
                    pathBuffer[++totalPath] = v;
                    dfsFlow(v, Math.min(bottleneck, edgeCap[u][v] - edgeFlow[u][v]));
                    if (!gridMark[0][0] || pathDetected) return;
                    pathBuffer[totalPath--] = 0;
                }
            }
            if (edgeFlow[v][u] > 0) {
                minH = Math.min(minH, height[v]);
                if (height[u] == height[v] + 1) {
                    pathBuffer[++totalPath] = -v;
                    dfsFlow(v, Math.min(bottleneck, edgeFlow[v][u]));
                    if (!gridMark[0][0] || pathDetected) return;
                    pathBuffer[totalPath--] = 0;
                }
            }
        }
        if (minH + 1 != height[u]) {
            --gap[height[u]];
            if (gap[height[u]] == 0) gridMark[0][0] = false;
            height[u] = minH + 1;
            ++gap[height[u]];
        }
    }

    static boolean findPath() {
        pathDetected = false;
        height[0] = sinkNode;
        totalPath = 0;
        pathBuffer[0] = 0;
        dfsFlow(0, sinkNode);
        return pathDetected;
    }

    static void adjustFlow() {
        for (int i = 1; i <= totalPath; ++i) {
            if (pathBuffer[i] > 0) {
                edgeFlow[Math.abs(pathBuffer[i - 1])][pathBuffer[i]] += height[0];
            } else {
                edgeFlow[-pathBuffer[i]][Math.abs(pathBuffer[i - 1])] -= height[0];
            }
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        m = sc.nextInt();
        threshold = sc.nextInt();
        
        int[][] dist = new int[12][12];
        int[][] a = new int[12][12];
        int[][] b = new int[12][12];
        
        gridMark = new boolean[12][12];
        baseGrid = new boolean[12][12];
        
        height = new int[202];
        gap = new int[203];
        edgeCap = new int[202][202];
        edgeFlow = new int[202][202];
        pathBuffer = new int[202];
        
        for (int i = 1; i <= m; ++i) {
            String line = sc.next();
            for (int j = 1; j <= m; ++j) {
                buffer[j] = line.charAt(j - 1);
                if (buffer[j] == 'Z') {
                    Cell start = new Cell(i, j, 0);
                    q.add(start);
                } else if (buffer[j] != 'Y') {
                    gridMark[i][j] = true;
                    baseGrid[i][j] = true;
                    dist[i][j] = threshold;
                    int val = buffer[j] - '0';
                    if (val > 0) {
                        a[i][j] = ++totalVertices;
                        edgeCap[0][totalVertices] = val;
                        sinkNode += val;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        
        System.arraycopy(gridMark, 0, baseGrid, 0, gridMark.length);
        
        for (int i = 1; i <= m; ++i) {
            String line = sc.next();
            for (int j = 1; j <= m; ++j) {
                buffer[j] = line.charAt(j - 1);
                if (buffer[j] == 'Z' || buffer[j] == 'Y') continue;
                int val = buffer[j] - '0';
                if (val > 0) {
                    b[i][j] = ++totalVertices;
                    edgeCap[totalVertices][m * m + 1] = val;
                }
            }
        }
        
        if (totalVertices != m * m) {
            for (int i = 1; i <= m; ++i)
                for (int j = 1; j <= m; ++j)
                    if (b[i][j] > 0) {
                        int idx = b[i][j];
                        edgeCap[idx][totalVertices + 1] = edgeCap[idx][m * m + 1];
                        edgeCap[idx][m * m + 1] = 0;
                    }
        }
        
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            Cell cur = q.poll();
            int r = cur.r, c = cur.c;
            dist[r][c] = cur.dis;
            for (int k = 0; k < 4; ++k) {
                int nr = r + dRow[k], nc = c + dCol[k];
                if (nr >= 0 && nr < 12 && nc >= 0 && nc < 12 && gridMark[nr][nc]) {
                    Cell next = new Cell(nr, nc, cur.dis + 1);
                    q.add(next);
                    gridMark[nr][nc] = false;
                }
            }
        }
        
        for (int i = 1; i <= m; ++i)
            for (int j = 1; j <= m; ++j) {
                if (a[i][j] == 0) continue;
                System.arraycopy(baseGrid, 0, gridMark, 0, gridMark.length);
                gridMark[i][j] = false;
                Cell start = new Cell(i, j, 0);
                q.add(start);
                while (!q.isEmpty()) {
                    Cell cur = q.poll();
                    int r = cur.r, c = cur.c;
                    if (b[r][c] > 0 && cur.dis <= dist[r][c]) {
                        edgeCap[a[i][j]][b[r][c]] = sinkNode;
                    }
                    if (cur.dis + 1 > threshold || cur.dis >= dist[r][c]) continue;
                    for (int k = 0; k < 4; ++k) {
                        int nr = r + dRow[k], nc = c + dCol[k];
                        if (nr >= 0 && nr < 12 && nc >= 0 && nc < 12 && gridMark[nr][nc]) {
                            Cell next = new Cell(nr, nc, cur.dis + 1);
                            q.add(next);
                            gridMark[nr][nc] = false;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        
        gap[0] = totalVertices + 2;
        gridMark[0][0] = true;
        while (gridMark[0][0] && height[0] <= totalVertices + 2) {
            while (findPath()) {
                adjustFlow();
            }
        }
        
        int result = 0;
        for (int i = 1; i <= totalVertices; ++i) {
            result += edgeFlow[i][totalVertices + 1];
        }
        System.out.println(result);
    }
}
